2608.18852.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents
2608.18852.paper_summary: Agent frameworks increasingly package procedural knowledge as skills: instruction files an agent reads on demand, while public libraries now hold thousands of them. Which skill to read has thus become a decision the policy itself makes in the middle of an episode, yet no existing signal trains it. We show that the default remedy, outcome-rewarded RL over the candidate slate, cannot teach it, for a structural reason we identify and name selector credit starvation: under a broadcast, sequence-level advantage, the few tokens that name the chosen skill carry a vanishing share of the loss, and the credit they inherit is increasingly wrong-signed as trajectories lengthen. A correct choice is punished whenever the execution after it fails, even though the choice itself is among the most valuable decisions in the trajectory. Auditing a completed run's own training artifacts confirms all three properties, each worsening monotonically with horizon. SkillGate removes the failure by construction: it partitions the token support into two disjoint credit channels, outcome credit reaching only execution tokens, and a separate action-local advantage reaching exactly the skill-naming tokens, positive only when a trajectory's single read is the correct one. On five agentic benchmarks under a 16-candidate slate, SkillGate lifts a 9B policy from 40.8% to 53.2% trial success, well ahead of the identical budget spent on outcome reward alone, while cutting exposure to misleading candidates by two thirds and reading fewer skills.
2608.18852.paper_summary_zh: 代理框架越來越多地將程序知識包裝為技能：代理根據需求閱讀的指令檔案，而公共庫現在擁有數千個這樣的檔案。因此，選擇閱讀哪項技能已成為政策在一個情節中所做的決策，但目前沒有現有的信號來訓練它。我們顯示，默認的補救措施，即在候選清單上進行結果獎勵的強化學習，無法教會它，因為我們識別並命名的結構性原因是選擇者信貸饑餓：在廣播的序列級優勢下，命名所選技能的少數標記承擔著逐漸消失的損失份額，而隨著軌跡的延長，它們所繼承的信貸越來越多地是錯誤的。每當其後的執行失敗時，正確的選擇就會受到懲罰，即使這個選擇本身在軌跡中是最有價值的決策之一。對已完成運行的訓練文物進行審核確認了所有三個屬性，並且每個屬性隨著時間的推移而單調惡化。SkillGate 通過構造消除了失敗：它將標記支持劃分為兩個不相交的信貸通道，結果信貸僅達到執行標記，而一個單獨的行動本地優勢則恰好達到命名技能的標記，僅在軌跡的單次閱讀是正確的時候為正。在五個代理基準下，SkillGate 將一個 90 億的政策從 40.8% 提升到 53.2% 的試驗成功率，遠遠超過僅在結果獎勵上花費的相同預算，同時將對誤導性候選者的曝光減少三分之二，並閱讀更少的技能。
